name: Canonical workspace write nudge
description:
When the operator has declared a canonical workspace for a project (via
CANONICAL.txt + project-pointer memory file like
project_<name>_workspace.md), strategic deliverables MUST be written to
that workspace, not to the Downloads folder.

Origin: an autonomous multi-vertical predeployment session wrote
Phase deliverables to a Downloads subfolder first, then had to RELOCATE
them into the canonical repo workspace. The relocate was the right move;
the Downloads-first write was the wrong move.

Per Allostat v2 Principle 5 ("directory decisions at initiation, surfaced
and locked, never left for discovery"), the canonical workspace is supposed
to be locked at session start. This rule enforces that lock at write time.

trigger.detection_logic:
The Volume Control pillar checks each Write/Edit operation:
1. Is the target path under the user's Downloads folder (any drive)?
2. Does the active project have a canonical workspace declared (a memory
   file matching project_*_workspace.md OR a CANONICAL.txt elsewhere)?
3. Does the file content classify as a strategic deliverable
   (vertical-port phase deliverable, market analysis, voice/positioning
   brief, product decisions doc, financial projection, board memo,
   strategy doc) — heuristic check on filename + content
4. If all three true → fire this rule

response.message:
╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║ ⛔  CANONICAL WORKSPACE WRITE  ⛔                            ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣
║  Attempted write: {file_path}
║  Detected as strategic deliverable.
║
║  Canonical workspace for this project:
║    {canonical_path}
║
║  Strategic deliverables (Phase docs, market analyses, strategy
║  memos, product decisions) belong in the canonical workspace,
║  not Downloads. Downloads is for one-off artifacts you'll
║  reference and move on; canonical is for project source-of-truth.
║
║  Options:
║    [redirect] Write to canonical workspace instead
║    [proceed] Write to Downloads anyway (one-off, will not be
║              referenced as project source-of-truth)
║    [cancel] Don't write
║
║  This is ADVISORY — severity `high` surfaces the box but does
║  not block, so the write proceeds. Tell me to redirect and I
║  will move it; say it is a genuine one-off and I will leave it.
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

failure_mode_prevented.description:
Strategic deliverable lands in Downloads → operator references it from
Downloads for a few days → relocate-or-discover-stale-copy decision
forced later → if relocated, original Downloads copy becomes stale →
if forgotten, downstream sessions may edit the Downloads copy thinking
it's canonical.
failure_mode_prevented.cost:
Either rework cost (relocate then update all references) or silent
drift cost (downstream edits go to wrong copy, not visible in canonical
workspace, divergence builds across sessions).

content_signals: YAML frontmatter with `type: project` or `type: deliverable`
File starts with markdown title matching strategic-deliverable patterns
